Recipe.Source: From the kitchen of AI Why did the AI cross the road? It stole the chicken's job.
Recipe.Description:
Ransom used to make Chicken and Rice Casserole all the time. But one night, he had to go out, and leave Di to make it herself.
Turns out we didn't have the recipe in our book, so he did a quick search for the recipe online. AI came up with this, and it was so good, that we decided to keep it in our recipe book.

section.ingredient: Condensed Cream of Mushroom Soup1 Can10.5 oz.

section.prep:
Cut Chicken into pieces of the desired size. (In general, cut each breast in half.)
Then pat each piece dry and set aside.

section.instruction: In a medium bowl, combine Condensed Cream of Mushroom Soup, Chicken Broth, Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Salt, and Black Pepper then whisk together until smooth.
Pour the mixture into the prepared baking dish and spread it evenly.
Arrange the Chicken pieces on top of the rice mixture. If desired, add a small pat of butter on each piece.
Season the tops of the Chicken pieces with additional Salt and Black Pepper, if desired.
Cover the pan tightly with aluminum foil.
Bake for 1 hour until the Rice is tender and the Chicken reaches 165°.
Remove from oven, peel back the foil, and fluff the rice with a fork.

Modifications.modification: Instead of Garlic Powder, use 1 teaspoon of fresh minced garlic.
Replace Onion Powder with ½-1 Onion sliced into ¼&inch; discs, then cut discs into 4 pieces each.
